answer: No. Your dad can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2, which can be signed electronically with no notary; only Georgia still requires notarization. NW-POA-2 replaced the older notarized NW-POA-1 on February 1, 2026, and an NW-POA-1 signed before that date was accepted only until June 30, 2026, so it can no longer be used. Bring the POA, your own photo ID (in Virginia, a state mobile ID on your phone is accepted), and the car's documents.
